80 oscillators with a measured amplitude and a half-life (loop 123's set, its max-fold duplicate rule)
BASELINE, as recorded: 72.5% exceed tanh(b*T/4) at T = 24 h
X1 THE NOISE FLOOR UNDER THE AMPLITUDE
(max-min)/(2*mean) on six unreplicated points is biased UP: noise raises the max and
lowers the min. A flat protein returns a positive apparent amplitude, and that bias
inflates the very statistic used to clear the ceiling.
per-protein noise from the median absolute successive difference on log intensity:
simulated apparent amplitude of a TRULY FLAT protein at each protein's own sigma:
against a median MEASURED amplitude of 0.4453
amplitude minus its own noise-only MEAN            62.5%
amplitude minus its own noise-only 95th percentile 40.0%
exceeds the ceiling AND its own 95th-pct null      55.0%
the ceiling result survives its own noise floor: 62% still exceed after subtracting the apparent amplitude that noise alone produces. The bias is real but it is not what produced the result.
cycle length is not the load-bearing number; the result holds across the whole defensible band.
X3 THE HALF-LIFE TRANSFER (mouse NIH3T3 -> human NB4)
conclusion flips when every half-life is wrong by 2.0x in the same direction
the transfer would have to be wrong by 2.0x across the whole proteome, in one direction, to overturn it. Species transfer error of that size is not plausible.
saturation reached at 300.0 s per substrate
the repo used 1-3 s. Single-molecule work on the 26S puts engagement plus unfolding plus translocation in the tens of seconds to minutes for many substrates,
so 1-3 s is the OPTIMISTIC end of a wide range and it was chosen, not measured.

the elimination reverses at 300 s per substrate. That is inside the range real proteasomal degradation takes, so protease competition is NOT ruled out -- it is ruled out AT 1-3 s, which is an assumption and not a measurement. This one is hostage to a single literature scalar and should be relabelled from 'ruled out' to 'ruled out conditionally'.
X5 THE SCOPE THAT WAS NEVER IN THE HEADLINE
the ceiling argument rules out production ONLY for the oscillators that exceed it.
for the other 30 (37.5%), production is NOT ruled out and never was. 'Four mechanisms eliminated' has been quoted in this arc
without that qualifier and it should not be again.
X6 WHAT 'FOR SURE' CAN AND CANNOT MEAN HERE
transcription / TF networks / translation (4)    robust, and only for the 62% that exceed the ceiling
protease competition (1)                         ruled out CONDITIONALLY on a 1-3 s sweep time; reverses at 300 s
the equation form (iv)                           not testable on anything in this repo -- needs single-cell time-lapse, not population mass spectrometry
A null is not made certain by more evidence. It is made robust by naming the number
it is most sensitive to and showing the conclusion survives that number's range.
Two of the five are now robust in that sense. One is hostage to a scalar nobody in
this repo measured. One is untestable here and is labelled so.
